# SelfOrganizedCriticality

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A dynamical state in which a system naturally evolves to a critical point characterized by power-law distributed neuronal avalanches, without external tuning. Provides a theoretical framework for designing neuromorphic hardware that exhibits optimal information transmission and computational capacity at the edge of stability.
